# Home Maintenance Skill for Muse

A practical home-maintenance and living-space guide: safety first (gas and electrical work go to licensed pros only, monthly smoke-detector tests, space-heater clearance), preventive upkeep (HVAC filters every 1–3 months, gutter cleaning before rainy season, yearly caulking inspections), energy savings (thermal curtains, draft stoppers, LEDs, ceiling-fan direction), smart-home reality checks (ecosystem lock-in, local control for locks and lights, physical key backups for smart locks), plus furniture layout rules, organization systems that survive real life, beginner-proof houseplants, and budget prioritization — paint first, fix problems before aesthetics. It starts by asking whether you rent or own, who lives there, and the room's actual dimensions. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a static knowledge guide, not a tool — nothing runs, nothing is automated; some tips are US-centered (seasonal sale timing, US paper/panel references); and the safety rules are strict by design — it will not talk you through anything dangerous. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
